description: answer-for-me: offer every AskUserQuestion dialog to this project's stand-in session (/answer-for-me), also one that goes on duty after the dialog opened. Claude Code runs this hook alongside the dialog; the user's pick or the stand-in's answer, whichever comes first, closes it. The hook exits when the dialog closes.
